changelog: Initial release: bulk translation tagging with Polish audio/subtitle auto-detection.
description: Bulk-tag movies by translation type (Napisy, Lektor, Dubbing, Brak Tłumaczenia) and auto-detect Polish audio/subtitles. Tags are stored as native Jellyfin tags so the library can be filtered by them immediately.
name: Translation Tags
overview: Tag movies by translation type and filter the library by tag.
